description: Traffico viali Bologna is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Rilevazione traffico per fascia oraria e tratta, lungo i viali di Bologna, mediante spire posizionate nell'asfalto. Il dataset contiene i dati dal 1 gennaio 2019 e si aggiorna entro ogni 15 del mese. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti. Its keywords are Mobilità persone e merci. The portal shows 7,424 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
